html:
This Ha Giang Easy Rider tour is perfect for travelers seeking an authentic and adventurous journey through one of the most spectacular landscapes in Vietnam. Travel on the back of experienced Easy Riders, explore breathtaking passes, ethnic villages, limestone karsts, and the legendary Mã Pí Lèng Pass overlooking the emerald Nho Que River.

Tour Overview

Hanoi → Ha Giang (By Sleeper Bus / Limousine Bus)

You will be picked up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter and transferred to Ha Giang by luxury sleeper bus or limousine (depending on your booking). Overnight in a traditional homestay in Ha Giang City.

Itinerary

Day 1: Ha Giang City – Bac Sum Slope – Quan Ba Heaven Gate – Twin Mountains – Yen Minh – Tham Ma Slope – H’Mong King Palace – Dong Van Town

Meals: Lunch, Dinner

08:30

The tour begins at our homestay in Ha Giang City. Your guide and Easy Riders will brief you on safety before starting the journey.

As you enter the mountainous area, the scenery changes dramatically. You will stop at:

  • Bac Sum Slope – a beautiful viewpoint

  • Quan Ba Heaven Gate – overlooking the iconic

  • Twin Mountains (Fairy Bosom Hills)

Travel through the Dong Van Karst Plateau Geopark, a UNESCO-recognized geological treasure filled with limestone formations, rice terraces, and remote ethnic villages.

Lunch at a local restaurant in Yen Minh Town.

Continue to:

  • Tham Ma Slope – famous for its winding curves

  • H’Mong King Palace (Vuong Family Residence) – the historical home of the H’Mong royal family

Arrive in Dong Van Town, check in at the homestay, and enjoy dinner with local dishes.

Day 2: Dong Van – Volunteer Youth Monument – Ma Pi Leng Pass – Nho Que River Viewpoint – Meo Vac – Ha Giang → Hanoi

Meals: Breakfast, Lunch

After breakfast, begin the most stunning part of the journey:

  • Visit the Volunteer Youth Monument

  • Conquer the legendary Ma Pi Leng Pass, known as the most beautiful pass in Vietnam

  • Enjoy panoramic views over the Nho Que River and deep valleys

This is the highlight of the Ha Giang Loop—breathtaking cliffs, dramatic mountains, and unforgettable viewpoints.

Ride toward Meo Vac, then return through scenic backroads to Yen Minh and continue to Ha Giang City.

Along the way, you will encounter various ethnic groups such as the H’Mong, Tay, and Dao—recognizable by their colorful traditional clothing and highland lifestyle.

17:00

Tour ends in Ha Giang City.

20:30

Board the private-cabin sleeper bus back to Hanoi.

Tour Price (USD per person)

148 USD – SIC Group Tour

192 USD – Private Tour

Tour Includes

  • Round-trip transportation Hanoi ↔ Ha Giang

    • Luxury sleeper bus (private cabin) OR limousine bus

  • Free homestay in Ha Giang City (traditional house)

  • Accommodation: Private room in homestay

  • Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

  • Professional English-speaking guide

  • Experienced Easy Riders

  • Motorbikes & fuel

  • Protective gear: helmet, raincoat

  • All entrance fees

  • Drinking water (1 bottle/day)

Tour Excludes

  • Border entry permit (if required)

  • Tips for guide and riders

  • Personal drinks (beer, coffee, etc.)
